topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna directly impacts link budget calculations by reducing the available transmit and receive power. This reduction necessitates recalibration of the link budget parameters such as transmit power, noise temperature, and interference mitigation techniques. Lower power levels require higher transmitter power and more stringent noise temperature requirements to ensure reliable transmission. Additionally, reduced efficiency increases interference levels, necessitating better noise temperature compensation. Path loss and distance contribute to higher power requirements, further complicating the link budget calculations. Each factor—transmitter power, noise temperature, interference, path loss, and data rate—must be adjusted in link budget calculations to maintain system performance.
